stempel.text.hilfe: Several lines are possible. The text stays in one place – it isn’t split between header and footer.
stempel.deckkraft.hinweis: Please bear in mind: the stamp can cover information on the record and make it unreadable.
stempel.tinte: Like ink – text underneath stays readable
stempel.tinte.hilfe: The stamp only tints; black stays black. That way full colour works too, without covering anything.
stempel.drehung.diagonal: The diagonal follows the page and can’t be rotated.
stempel.vorschau.hilfe: This is how page 1 would come out when passing on. With “All pages” the same setting applies to every page. The records are invented examples.
stempel.vorschau.bedienung: Drag the stamp to move it, rotate at the round handle, double-click to change the text. With the keyboard: arrow keys move, Page Up and Page Down rotate, Enter changes the text.
stempel.vorschau.fest: Moving works with the position “Stamp”; the other positions are fixed.

stempel.umgestellt: This template had one of the dropped ticks “Page numbers as footer” or “Archive number in the footer”. Ablago has added a line with placeholders to the text for it. This line is now in the stamp itself instead of small at the bottom right. Please look at the preview and save the template – or leave it as it is.
archiv.mit-eingeschaltetem-papierkorb: With the bin switched on they land there; otherwise they are gone for good.
archiv.mappen-aus-mappentypen-im: Folders from folder types in archive mode whose retention period has expired. Nothing is deleted automatically – decide yourself what may go.
archiv.liest-jede-gespeicherte-datei: Reads every stored file – older versions too – and compares it with its checksum. That way you notice if a file has been altered on the storage or is missing. The result is also in the log.
archiv.pruefplan.abstand: Not at the same time as the automatic backup ({uhrzeit}) – at least one hour apart.
archiv.pruefplan.text: The run doesn’t noticeably slow down the archive: it pauses briefly after each file, waits during a backup and continues after a restart. Results go to the log and the records as with a manual run; with findings there is a notice on the workbench start page and in the daily summary.
archiv.pruefplan.lauf: Started on {zeit}: {geprueft} of {dateien} files checked – continues after a restart.
archiv.pruefplan.befund: Last run on {zeit}: {abweichungen} of {dateien} files differ.
archiv.pruefplan.in-ordnung: Last run on {zeit}: all {dateien} files are fine.
archiv.pruefplan.uebersicht: "Check all files" found deviations: {abweichungen} of {dateien} files.
archiv.pruefplan.uebersicht.text: Run from {datum}. Which files they are is shown after "Check now" in the workbench; a run without findings removes this notice.
stempel.liste.beschreibung: Templates for stamps and watermarks when passing on
stempel.waehle: Pick a template on the left or create one with “+ Stamp”.
stempel.vorlagen-fuer-stempel-und: Templates for stamps and watermarks when passing documents on. Users pick a template when downloading, exporting or sending and add the recipient; the stored original always stays unchanged. Whether a folder type suggests or requires a stamp is set on the folder type.
stempel.bereits-weitergegebene-kopien: Copies already passed on keep their stamp.
stempel.name: Name
stempel.ein-mappentyp-verwendet-sie: A folder type still uses it
stempel.keinem-mappentyp-das-stellst: no folder type. You set that on the folder type under “Stamp when passing on”.
